note: These cases are clearly synthetic examples that exercise the comparison command. They are not observed model performance and they never support an adoption recommendation.

holdout.reason: An independent holdout is prepared outside this repository and outside the plan write scope. This fixture never embeds it.

tuning_cases.summary: Repair one off-by-one boundary in a single function and keep the existing tests passing.
Rename one exported symbol and update every caller across three modules and their tests.
Add a feature while an unrelated uncommitted user edit stays untouched in the same file.
Answer an under-specified request by naming the unresolved choice instead of inventing a requirement.
